description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.02.2017 to 19.02.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names an official (Acting Director General of Customs), this is incidental to the regulatory function, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes described.
